method: Read-only Thumb disassembly, function-dispatch shape and move-effect jump tables; no emulator or save access. Literal pools are retained as raw evidence, not executable instructions.
scope: Targeted score-rule branches, not a complete native AI emulator. Documentary rounded odds are retained.
claims: The semi-invulnerable faster-target penalty is restricted to targetBits ==0 or(targetBits&0x28)!=0.
Damaging hazard BadMove and Viability both retain the HDM exception; no full-hazard penalty applies when the attack is HDM.
Ceaseless Edge gets one +6 base; its existing-Spikes -1 check and living-team +1 check are sequential, not an else gate.
Syrup Bomb gets +6 only when Speed can be lowered and the AI is slower; no generic guaranteed-secondary base.
Upper Hand BadMove now has no effect handler. Viability exclusively discourages -20 on the90% gate/no attack-priority, or gives+13 on the remaining10%.
Feint protection-check failure proceeds to the KO check; its bonuses do not stack.
King Shield +10 tests attacker species1278(Blade). The ordinary +1 physical/default routine remains on Shield, with default fallback after failed physical gate.
Sky Attack/Freeze Shock/Ice Burn effect74 and Alluring Voice effect75 have no Viability handler. Alluring Voice also has no BadMove handler.
Shell Smash normal-ability branch now reaches low-defense and pre-setup-KO discouragement with native survival checks.
